# Ritvij Kumar Sharma

> Personal site of Ritvij Kumar Sharma — a software engineer (currently Principal Engineer at Kendal AI) who builds clean, accessible, robust software. Site is a single-page portfolio with anchored sections for about, experience, projects, and contact. Domain: https://ritvij.dev

## About
Ritvij is a software engineer with ~5 years of hands-on experience across the stack. Current work: Kendal AI's AI-powered CRM for real estate brokerages (60+ brokerages, 800+ agents). Previously at Huddle01 (WebRTC/Web3) and AgNext. Background in scalable systems, search infrastructure (ElasticSearch over 10M records), and full-stack product engineering.

## Projects
- [ASCII Camera](https://ascii-cam.ritvij.dev): Convert a webcam feed or image into ASCII art in real time, in-browser. Built with React, Tanstack Router, Tailwind, Vite.
- [numis](https://numis.ritvij.dev): Natural-language parser for monetary values — extracts money from text the way a human reads it. TypeScript, React, Vite.
